# jidonglab
> jidonglab (지동랩) is the personal site and portfolio of an independent AI product builder based in Seoul, Korea. The site collects build logs, project notes, and articles in Korean and English.

jidonglab.com is the homepage of jidonglab. The author builds and operates small AI products, ops automation, and small web products solo — model, server, frontend, billing, deploy, support all handled by one person.

## Entity
- Name: jidonglab
- Korean name: 지동랩
- Role: Independent AI product builder
- Location: Seoul, Korea (KST · UTC+9)
- Languages: Korean, English
- Contact: jidongs45@gmail.com
- Primary site: https://jidonglab.com

## Focus areas
- AI / LLM products with billing, auth, and UI built in
- Ops automation (ad-ops, content pipelines, bilingual logs, news curation)
- Small SaaS and company websites in Next.js and Astro
- Technical writing and Korean-language books about Claude and Claude Code

## Stack
- Languages: TypeScript
- Frameworks: Astro, Next.js, React
- Models / SDKs: Anthropic Claude API
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages, Vercel
- Storage: Upstash Redis
